mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona City Hall with temperatures at 77 degrees. The air quality index is currently 54. Expect a low of 67 degrees overnight with no rain predicted.

For city news, the engineering department continues to update council reports regularly online. Also, don't forget the tri-shaw bike program at the senior center, where you can volunteer as a pilot or take a free ride on the Military Ridge State Trail.

There is plenty to do today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at the Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding the weekly police report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop for an equipment violation and subsequently located marijuana, resulting in drug-related citations for the passengers.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and they are open until 10 PM. Also, Kona Ice will be at Fireman's Park today until 4 PM.
